description.en: Used the quantum number itself instead of its square.
description.et: Kasutas kvantarvu ennast, mitte selle ruutu.

description.en: Divided by the box length itself instead of its square.
description.et: Jagas kasti pikkusega endaga, mitte selle ruuduga.

description.en: Multiplied by the box length squared instead of dividing by it, so energy incorrectly grows with a larger box.
description.et: Korrutas kasti pikkuse ruuduga, selle asemel et sellega jagada, mistõttu energia kasvab ekslikult suurema kasti korral.
